dataset.name: SDWPF
dataset.selection_leakage_guard: power values and TEST labels are excluded from turbine selection
dataset.selected_turbine_ids_status: filled from the immutable coordinate file before formal training; unresolved because raw SDWPF coordinates are not present in this repository

turbine_selection.rule: sort IDs, select lexicographically first turbine, then greedily maximize minimum squared Euclidean distance; ties by turbine ID

time_protocol.split_rule: first 70% continuous timestamps LS, next 15% VS, final 15% TEST
time_protocol.window_rule: discard windows whose context and target cross split boundaries

models.hardware: not used in SDWPF-5 formal run unless separately approved

randomness.seed_aggregation: compute metrics per seed, then aggregate across seeds

statistics.primary_comparison: paired daily block bootstrap over forecast dates
statistics.secondary_test: two-sided paired sign-flip/permutation test on daily blocks
statistics.multiple_comparison: Holm correction across pre-specified secondary metrics

stopping_rules.early_stopping_metric: VS negative log-likelihood or pre-specified validation loss
stopping_rules.smoke_failure: stop and fix pipeline before formal seeds
stopping_rules.formal_run_stop: stop only for reproducible data/schema/resource failure; do not stop based on TEST score
